failure.denied: You cannot see {section} in this workspace. The roles you hold do not include {permission}. An owner can grant it.
failure.pendingApproval: Your request to see {section} is waiting for approval: {accessRequestId}.
failure.error: {section} could not be loaded: {code}. Nothing was changed.

freshness.title: Steering freshness
freshness.lead: An agent reads the records in the checkout it is running in. These two switches decide what happens when that checkout is behind the production branch.
freshness.unbound: No repository is bound, so steering is off for this workspace.
freshness.autoSyncHint: Take the records merged on the production branch into the developer's checkout before the prompt runs. It never runs while .oxagen/ holds uncommitted work or records the branch is still authoring.
freshness.blockStaleRunsHint: Stop a prompt while the checkout is missing records that are in force. The developer is warned either way. Run oxagen steering hooks install on each machine for this to reach the prompt.

records.title: Published records
records.lead: A record is in force because a Context PR merged its file into .oxagen/rules/ on the production branch. Saving it here publishes nothing.
records.empty: Published records live in .oxagen/rules/ on the workspace repository. A proposal becomes a record when its Context PR merges.
records.emptyKind: No record of that kind is in force in this workspace.
records.authority: A record never grants authority. A constraint can only require or forbid, and a repository record can narrow what a workspace record allows, never widen it.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.lead: A proposal steers nothing. It publishes only when its Context PR passes every check and merges.
proposals.empty: Agents propose records through context/append, and a person proposes one with oxagen context propose. Each proposal waits here for a person to open its Context PR or dismiss it.
proposals.support: Support: {runs} runs, {agents} agents, {records} records, {evidence} evidence links

prs.title: Context PRs
prs.lead: One concern, one pull request. The six checks run the same rules as stella context validate.
prs.empty: No proposal on this page has a Context PR.

pr.heading: Context PR
pr.title: Context PR for {lineage}
pr.rejected: This proposal was dismissed. Its pull request is closed and its branch deleted.
pr.notOpened: No pull request is open for this proposal yet.
pr.modeUnread: read from .oxagen/rules/governance.toml when the pull request opens

modes.solo: solo: any workspace member merges, the author included
modes.team: team: an org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner, other than the author merges
modes.regulated: regulated: an org Owner or Admin other than the author merges, recorded as the accountable approver

names.constraint_effect: Constraint effect is require or forbid

onMerge.title: What merge will do
onMerge.publishes: Publish {path} as a record in force
onMerge.version: Move this workspace from steering version {current} to {next}
onMerge.promotion: Write the promotion event to the ledger and a steering_published audit event

open.title: Open a Context PR
open.body: Oxagen opens a branch with the one record file, opens the pull request with the rationale and support, and runs the six checks one at a time. Merge is the publication.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this proposal
dismiss.body: A dismissed proposal steers nothing. An open Context PR for it is closed and its branch deleted.

merge.blocked: Merge is blocked until every check passes.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your role in this organization or workspace does not allow this change. Nothing was changed.
failure.noPrincipal: This change needs a signed-in person. Nothing was changed.
failure.separationOfDuties: Under this governance mode the author does not merge their own proposal. Another reviewer merges it.
failure.proposalNotFound: This proposal is not in this workspace.
failure.proposalMoved: This proposal changed after the page loaded. Reload the page to see where it is.
failure.lineagePrOpen: Another pull request is already open for this lineage. One concern, one pull request.
failure.governanceUnreadable: The workspace repository has a .oxagen/rules/governance.toml that could not be read, so nothing was opened or merged.
failure.repositoryMissing: This workspace has no connected GitHub repository to open the pull request on.
failure.checksNotPassed: Merge is blocked until every check passes.
failure.headMoved: The pull request changed after the checks ran. Run the checks again.
failure.baseMoved: The pull request no longer targets the production branch. Nothing was merged.
failure.githubRefused: GitHub refused the change. Nothing was published.
failure.mergeTimeUnknown: The pull request merged and GitHub has not said when, so nothing was published. Merge again to publish it.
failure.refused: The change was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.invalid: Write a reason before you dismiss the proposal.
failure.pendingApproval: The change is waiting for approval: {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The change could not be made: {code}. Nothing was changed.

deliveries.title: Steering delivery
deliveries.lead: The latest verified manifest for each recorded run in the last 7 days.
deliveries.empty: No steering manifests were recorded in this window. Older hosts may not report them.
deliveries.truncated: The window contains more than 2,000 manifests. These counts cover the newest 2,000.
deliveries.unreachedLead: These records were cut from every sampled manifest that considered them.
deliveries.noUnreached: Every candidate record appeared in at least one sampled manifest.
